comment: Hand-authored retrieval-quality golden set for fixtures/vault (10k notes, seed 42). Expected paths are vault-relative. Queries were written by reading each target article's prose; tags and See-also links in the fixture are randomly drawn and MUST NOT be used as relevance signals. kinds: 'semantic' = description-style, the headword never appears in the query; 'lexical' = exact/rare-term controls where keyword search should win; 'topical' = multi-note subjects, hit@5 counts any expected path. SHA-312: every query carries a 'split' (dev|holdout) assigned at authoring time and immutable thereafter — tuning reads dev only, gate v2 reports on holdout only. The original 50 queries (pre-SHA-312, content verbatim) are pinned to dev: they were already used as tuning targets by the SHA-307 fusion selection. New queries were stratified ~60/40 per subset by a fixed interleaving pattern (positions 1 and 4 of each successive block of 5 authored queries go to dev), fixed before any retrieval system was run against them.
